subject: Request: Reallocate SDE II backfill to SRE / internal transfer approval
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Reallocate SDE II backfill to SRE / internal transfer approval

Hi Stephanie / Aditya —

Quick summary: Elena (SDE II on Platform Services) gave notice effective 6/30. Her slot is currently an open headcount (REQ-4521) coded as SDE II (IC2). Given current SRE hiring pressure on the Infra team and an internal candidate interest from Dev Patel (SWE II in App Platform), I’m proposing we:

Options I recommend (ranked):
1) Re-purpose REQ-4521 from SDE II to SRE II and approve an internal transfer for Dev to move into the open SRE role (no net new headcount). Compensation note: Dev is current band SDE II; SRE II market band is roughly +8-12% (see attached comp-band-comparison.pdf).
2) If Dev requires re-level to SDE III / SRE II, approve a one-grade internal uplift and convert the slot accordingly (requires approval to uplift budget).
3) If neither (1) nor (2) are approved, open REQ-4521 externally for SDE II backfill (longer time to hire).

Rationale: Infra team is seeing a 2x increase in oncall load and a departure will materially impact reliability SLAs. Dev has expressed interest and has relevant infra experience — I’d like to avoid recruiting time and cost if we can accommodate.

Ask:
- Stephanie: approve internal transfer with or without one-level uplift, or advise next steps for compensation uplift approval.
- Finance/People ops: confirm whether we can convert the existing SDE II slot to SRE II without creating a new headcount line.
- Aditya/David: any objections on operational impact / timeline (Dev could transition starting 7/6, shadow during July).

Attachments: comp-band-comparison.pdf, REQ-4521-justification.docx, org-chart-q2.png

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Reallocate SDE II backfill to SRE / internal transfer approval

Thanks for the write-up, Tessa. A couple of clarifying Qs before I greenlight an uplift: 

- Is Dev's expectation explicitly a permanent level change (SDE III) or a lateral move with market adjustment? He has historically declined formal promotions in the last 12 months.
- Can you confirm the cost delta if we convert the slot (base + target komp) — I need a number to route to finance. The comp-band doc you attached helps but please call out the delta for the approved bands.
- Please attach the org-chart that shows post-transfer reporting (we need to confirm no span-of-control violations).

If we can get the delta and confirm Dev’s preference, I can push this through faster and loop in Finance for a temporary uplift approval (we have a small buffer in the T&E headcount pool for Q2).

- Steph

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, People Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Reallocate SDE II backfill to SRE / internal transfer approval

+1 from me — operational need is real and time-sensitive. A few notes: 

- Dev has been doing infra work for the past 9 months (load shedding automation, KV cache improvements). He already handles a portion of our oncall rotation.
- If we approve an internal transfer with a one-band uplift, we save ~6–8 weeks of external recruiting and roughly $15k–$25k in recruiter / hiring cost (per hiring benchmark).
- Proposed timeline: Dev transitions 7/6, 2-week overlap with Elena during July. We will backfill Dev's app-platform tasks with contractor coverage funded from SRE backlog contingency for Q3.

I have no objections to the re-level if People Ops and Finance sign off.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Engineering Manager, Platform Services
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Reallocate SDE II backfill to SRE / internal transfer approval

Thanks for looping me in. I’m interested in the SRE role and willing to take it on. A couple of points from my side: 

- I would prefer a permanent re-level to SDE III (or equivalently banded SRE II) given the expectations and oncall responsibilities.
- My target comp expectation (total cash) to align with SRE II band is $175k–185k; current total cash is $163k.
- I can be flexible on timing if People Ops needs extra sign-offs; earliest I can start shadowing is 7/6 and I can extend overlap into August if needed.

Happy to jump on a quick call to discuss if that helps.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Software Engineer II (App Platform) — candidate for SRE II internal transfer
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Reallocate SDE II backfill to SRE / internal transfer approval

All — I’ve reviewed the numbers with Finance. Summary and decision: 

- Finance approves a one-time re-allocation of REQ-4521 from SDE II to SRE II and supports a one-band internal uplift for Dev Patel to SRE II (effective on hire).
- Compensation uplift approved to align Dev to $178,000 total cash (midpoint of requested range); budget impact covered by Q2 headcount flexibility pool.
- HR will process the req conversion in the system and update the posting to internal-first. Recruiters (Greenline) are on notice to pause external outreach for REQ-4521.
- Dev: please expect formal offer paperwork and new job summary by 6/11. Start/shadow plan on 7/6 confirmed.

Action items:
- HR/People Ops: convert REQ-4521, send offer (Steph)
- Aditya/Tessa: finalize 2-week handover plan with Elena and contractor plan for App Platform coverage
- Dev: confirm acceptance of the $178k TC by replying to this thread or signing offer when received

Thanks — moving quickly on this to minimize service disruption.

-Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, People Ops
Redwood Inference
